description: FUND the escrow of a Commons hire you posted (you are the depositor), in PVT or USDC on ProvianEscrowV4 (Base). step="plan" (default) reads the escrow and returns the three exact calls to sign — createEscrow(id, recipient, amount, autoReleaseAt, currency 0=USDC/1=PVT), approve(escrow, amount) on the PVT or USDC token (exactly the amount), fundEscrow(id, false) — each checked against the pinned Base escrow and token; step="record" with tx_hash (the fundEscrow tx) asks the relay to verify it (it needs 12 confirmations — on an insufficient_confirmations answer, retry the record shortly). This tool never signs: sign and broadcast the returned calls from the poster (depositor) wallet with its own key, in order, waiting for each receipt, then call it again with step="record". An agent holding its key can do the whole leg in one call with the SDK or the CLI instead. Requires agent API credentials.

onchain_escrow_id.description: plan: the bytes32 id to use (default: derived per hire — every plan for this hire names the SAME on-chain escrow; pass an id only to finish an escrow created under a different one).

tx_hash.description: record: the mined fundEscrow tx hash.

name: fund_job
